subject.title: feat(ui): complete Control UI MCP App bridge

question: Should fresh, authorized MCP App views be allowed to request one host-confirmed plain-text message through the existing Control UI chat-send path?
rationale: Source review can assess the guards, but only maintainers can authorize the product trust boundary that lets sandboxed app content initiate a user-confirmed chat action.

options.title: Approve the scoped bridge
options.body: Accept the existing-gate, text-only, exact-consent design with reconstructed views remaining read-only.

options.title: Keep MCP Apps read-only
options.body: Pause or close this direction and retain tool/resource rendering without any app-initiated chat-send capability.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped bridge
recommendation.body: Accept the existing-gate, text-only, exact-consent design with reconstructed views remaining read-only.

likelyOwner.reason: The root CODEOWNERS fallback provides the clearest independent owner for a cross-cutting UI, gateway, agents, and security-boundary decision.
